events.title: The World Through AI — Schirn Kunsthalle Frankfurt
events.description: The Schirn Kunsthalle presents 'The World Through AI', a groundbreaking exhibition exploring the impact of artificial intelligence on contemporary art and visual culture. The show features works by international artists who use AI as both a tool and a subject, from AI-generated paintings and sculptures to interactive installations. Visitors can engage with works that learn and evolve in real time, creating a unique experience with each visit. The exhibition critically examines questions of authorship, creativity, and the boundaries between human and machine-made art. A special section offers hands-on demonstrations where visitors can create their own AI-assisted artworks. Running from June 11 to September 20, 2026, the exhibition is accompanied by a comprehensive public program including artist talks and workshops.
events.location: Schirn Kunsthalle, Römerberg, 60311 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Monets Küste: Die Entdeckung von Étretat — Städel Museum
events.description: The Städel Museum presents 'Monets Küste: Die Entdeckung von Étretat', a major special exhibition exploring Claude Monet's iconic paintings of the Normandy coastline. The exhibition brings together over 60 paintings and works on paper by Monet alongside works by contemporaries such as Courbet, Boudin, and Turner. It focuses on Monet's repeated visits to Étretat between 1883 and 1886, where he captured the dramatic chalk cliffs and sea arches from multiple perspectives. Interactive multimedia stations allow visitors to compare Monet's different interpretations of the same motif across seasons and times of day. The exhibition runs until July 5, 2026, and is accompanied by guided tours, lectures, and a richly illustrated catalogue. Audio guides are available in German and English, and the museum café offers a themed menu inspired by Normandy cuisine.
events.location: Städel Museum, Schaumainkai 63, 60596 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Elmgreen & Dragset: Stillleben mit Gemüse — Städel Museum
events.description: The Städel Museum presents a major solo exhibition by the celebrated Scandinavian artist duo Elmgreen & Dragset, titled 'Stillleben mit Gemüse' (Still Life with Vegetables). Known for their provocative and humorous installations that challenge museum conventions and social norms, the artists transform the Städel's exhibition spaces. The exhibition features a series of new site-specific works created for the Städel, alongside selected earlier pieces that explore themes of absence, desire, and display. Visitors encounter unexpected juxtapositions: classical sculpture meets contemporary objects, museum galleries become domestic interiors. The show runs from May 20, 2026 to January 2027, offering plenty of time to experience this landmark exhibition. A richly illustrated catalogue accompanies the exhibition, with insights from the artists and curators.
events.location: Städel Museum, Schaumainkai 63, 60596 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Bad Homburg Open — WTA 500 Tennis Tournament
events.description: The Bad Homburg Open is a world-class WTA 500 women's grass court tennis tournament, attracting top international players as a key Wimbledon warm-up event. Matches take place on meticulously maintained grass courts in the beautiful Kurpark setting, with the Tennishalle providing a covered center court. The week-long tournament runs June 22-28, culminating in the singles and doubles finals on Sunday, June 28. Spectators can enjoy world-class tennis up close, with practice courts offering opportunities to see players warming up. A public viewing area in the Kurpark screens matches on a large screen, with food and drink concessions creating a festival atmosphere. Day tickets start at €20, with hospitality packages and VIP experiences available for premium viewing.
events.location: TC Bad Homburg, Im Kurpark, 61348 Bad Homburg vor der Höhe

events.title: Rossini-Konzert — KammerChor Hofheim
events.description: The KammerChor Hofheim presents an evening of works by the great Italian composer Gioachino Rossini in a concert that showcases his choral and sacred music. The chamber choir, known for their precision and expressive warmth, performs Rossini's 'Petite Messe Solennelle' alongside other choral works. The concert takes place in one of Hofheim's historic venues, with the program offering a rare opportunity to hear Rossini's lesser-known sacred compositions. The chamber choir format allows for intimate, detailed interpretation of these intricate choral works. Tickets are approximately €15-20, supporting the local Hofheim music scene. This is a must for classical music enthusiasts and those seeking high-quality choral music in the Main-Taunus region.
events.location: Hofheim am Taunus, 65719 Hofheim am Taunus

events.title: Brüder Grimm Festspiele: Schneewittchen (Snow White)
events.description: The Brüder Grimm Festspiele in Hanau present 'Schneewittchen' (Snow White), a magical open-air theatre production in the historic Amphitheater at Schloss Philippsruhe. The classic fairy tale is brought to life with stunning costumes, original music, and a talented ensemble cast in the evocative setting of the castle grounds. The production runs 19 performance dates from June 18 through July 29, 2026, with evening shows starting at 20:30. The amphitheater's natural setting creates an enchanting atmosphere as dusk falls during performances. The Brüder Grimm Festspiele are Hanau's signature summer cultural event, celebrating the city's legacy as the birthplace of the Brothers Grimm. Tickets range from €18 to €35, with family packages available; pre-show dining is offered at the Schloss restaurant.

events.title: A Step Ahead — 125 Jahre Mathildenhöhe Darmstadt
events.description: The major anniversary exhibition 'A Step Ahead' celebrates 125 years since the first Darmstadt Artists' Colony exhibition in 1901 at the UNESCO World Heritage Mathildenhöhe. The exhibition connects the historic ideas of the colony with contemporary questions about design, sustainability, and social development. Over 400 exhibits include furniture, architecture models, graphic art, textiles, and decorative arts from the colony's four historic exhibitions between 1901 and 1914. Works by Joseph Maria Olbrich, Peter Behrens, and other colony artists are displayed alongside contemporary commissions that respond to their legacy. The Mathildenhöhe ensemble, with its iconic Hochzeitsturm (Wedding Tower) and exhibition building, provides a breathtaking setting. The exhibition runs from June 6, 2026 to January 31, 2027, with guided tours and special events throughout its duration.

events.title: Wetzlarer Festspiele — A Scottish Night
events.description: The 73rd Wetzlarer Festspiele presents 'A Scottish Night' at the Freilichtbühne Rosengärtchen, featuring traditional Scottish music and dance. The performance brings together LAGANA, UniCeltics, ClanPipers Frankfurt, a choir, and a string orchestra for an evening of bagpipes, fiddles, and Celtic melodies. The open-air stage in the Rosengärtchen (Rose Garden) provides a stunning natural setting with views over the Lahn Valley. The Wetzlarer Festspiele are the city's premier summer cultural event, running from June 9 through August 1, 2026, under the motto 'Live is Beautiful.' The diverse program includes opera, plays, concerts, and cabaret performances suitable for all tastes. Tickets range from €15 to €47, with discounted rates for students and groups.

events.title: Talentschmiede Konzert — Limburg
events.description: The 'Talentschmiede' (Talent Forge) concert at the Stadthalle Limburg showcases the finest young musicians from the Kreismusikschule and the Hochschule Mainz. Rising classical musicians perform works by Mozart, Beethoven, and contemporary composers, demonstrating the region's musical talent pipeline. The concert is free and open to all, making it an accessible introduction to classical music for new audiences. The Stadthalle Limburg (Josef-Kohlmaier-Halle) provides excellent acoustics for this intimate chamber music presentation. Programs are typically 60 minutes with no intermission, featuring solo and small ensemble performances. Free entry and a relaxed atmosphere make this an ideal evening out for music lovers of all ages.
events.location: Stadthalle Limburg, 65549 Limburg an der Lahn

events.title: Peter Maffay & Band — Love Places 2026, Fulda Domplatz
events.description: German rock legend Peter Maffay and his band perform at the spectacular Domplatz in Fulda as part of his Love Places 2026 tour. The open-air concert takes place on the cathedral square, with the majestic Fulda Cathedral (Baroque masterpiece) as a breathtaking backdrop. Maffay performs his greatest hits spanning five decades, from 'Über sieben Brücken musst du gehn' to songs from his latest album. This is an additional concert date added due to popular demand following the sold-out original show during the Hessentag. The Domplatz venue accommodates approximately 7,000 spectators, creating an intimate yet grand atmosphere. Tickets are available via Eventim, with standing and seated options available.

events.title: Musical Sommer: 'Der Schimmelreiter' — Weltpremiere Fulda
events.description: The Musical Sommer Fulda presents the world premiere of 'Der Schimmelreiter', a mystery musical adapted from Theodor Storm's classic 19th-century novella. Produced by spotlight musicals, the production features an original score, elaborate sets, and a talented ensemble cast. The story follows Hauke Haien, a driven dike master whose ambition leads him into a dark pact with supernatural forces, embodied by the ghostly white horse of the title. The renovated Schlosstheater Fulda provides a magnificent venue for this ambitious new German musical production. The show runs from June 19 through August 30, 2026, with evening performances Tuesday through Sunday. Tickets start at €49.90, with premium packages including dinner at the adjacent castle restaurant available.

events.title: Bad Hersfelder Festspiele — Open Air Theater
events.description: The Bad Hersfelder Festspiele are among Germany's most prestigious open-air theatre festivals, held in the magnificent Stiftsruine (monastery ruins). The summer season features major productions including classics, dramas, and musicals in the spectacular ruin setting. The 2026 program includes a mix of established favorites and new productions, performed by a talented ensemble of German actors. The atmospheric ruins, illuminated after dark, create a magical backdrop that has made these festival performances famous since 1951. Pre-show dining options are available at restaurants near the venue, and guided tours of the ruins are offered before performances. Tickets range from €20 to €65 depending on seating category and production.

events.title: Apparat (Sascha Ring) — Kulturzelt Kassel
events.description: Sascha Ring, better known as Apparat, brings his genre-defying electronic music to the Kulturzelt Kassel's summer festival series. Known for his work as one-half of Moderat and his acclaimed solo albums like 'LP5' and 'TTV', Apparat blends ambient textures, pulsing beats, and haunting melodies. His live performances are immersive audiovisual experiences featuring synchronized projections and atmospheric lighting. The concert is part of the 39th Kulturzelt Kassel festival, which runs June 19 through July 19, 2026, under the iconic big tent by the Fulda River. The Kulturzelt's intimate setting provides excellent acoustics and a close connection between artist and audience. Food and drink vendors serve regional specialties and festival classics before and during the show.
events.location: Kulturzelt Kassel, Fuldaaue (An der Drahtbrücke), 34131 Kassel

events.title: Powerful Textures: Sprache in Textil — Klingspor Museum
events.description: The Klingspor Museum in Offenbach presents 'Powerful Textures: Sprache in Textil', a unique exhibition exploring the intersection of language and textile art. The show features modern tapestry and textile letter-art, with works by Rudolf Koch and international artists who use fabric, thread, and weaving as their medium for typographic expression. Exquisite calligraphic textiles, embroidered manuscripts, and woven letter compositions demonstrate the ancient tradition of combining text with textile. The exhibition runs from May 9 to August 16, 2026, and is accompanied by workshops where visitors can try their hand at textile lettering. The Klingspor Museum is renowned for its collection of modern book art, typography, and calligraphy from around the world. Open Tuesday through Sunday 11:00-17:00, Wednesday until 19:00.
events.location: Klingspor Museum Offenbach, Herrnstraße 80, 63065 Offenbach am Main

events.title: GrimmsMärchenReich — Hanau Mitmachmuseum
events.description: The GrimmsMärchenReich (Grimms' Fairy Tale Kingdom) in Hanau is an interactive hands-on museum where children and families can step into the world of the Brothers Grimm. Through play, exploration, and creative activities, visitors experience classic fairy tales like Hansel and Gretel, Little Red Riding Hood, and The Frog King. Each exhibit is designed to be touched, manipulated, and explored — from climbing through giant storybook pages to dressing up as fairy tale characters. The museum is located in the historic Congress Park Hanau, adjacent to the Amphitheater at Schloss Philippsruhe. Entry is €2-10 depending on age, and free for children under 3, with special family packages available. The museum is open Tuesday through Sunday 10:00-17:00, offering a perfect family-friendly activity in Hanau.
events.location: Congress Park Hanau / Schloss Philippsruhe, 63450 Hanau

events.title: Sui Generis — Molinier / Aubrit / Beillard Kunsthalle Gießen
events.description: The Kunsthalle Gießen presents 'Sui Generis', a provocative exhibition featuring the controversial French artist Pierre Molinier alongside a film and installation project by artist duo Aubrit & Beillard. Molinier (1900-1976) was known for his erotic photomontages and fetishistic self-portraits that challenged social and artistic conventions of his time. Aubrit & Beillard's contemporary film installation creates a dialogue with Molinier's transgressive oeuvre, exploring themes of identity, desire, and the body. The exhibition offers a rare opportunity to see Molinier's work in Germany, as his pieces are seldom exhibited outside France. Entry to the Kunsthalle Gießen is free, making this challenging and thought-provoking art accessible to everyone. The exhibition runs until July 5, 2026, with hours Tuesday through Friday 14:00-18:00 and weekends 11:00-18:00.

events.title: Marburger Schlosskonzerte: Tenebrae — Pergolesi & Bach
events.description: The Marburger Schlosskonzerte present the acclaimed vocal ensemble Tenebrae performing works by Pergolesi and Bach in the historic Elisabethkirche. Tenebrae, one of Britain's finest vocal groups, is renowned for their exceptional blend, precision, and emotional depth in Renaissance and Baroque repertoire. The program features Pergolesi's heartbreaking 'Stabat Mater' paired with Bach's intimate motets, creating a transcendent evening of sacred music. The Elisabethkirche, one of the first pure Gothic churches in Germany, provides stunning acoustics and a contemplative atmosphere. This concert is part of the Marburger Schlosskonzerte's summer series, which attracts world-class performers to this historic university city. Tickets range from €17.50 to €29, with student discounts available.

events.title: Catherine Opie — Erste institutionelle Einzelausstellung in Deutschland
events.description: The Fridericianum in Kassel presents the first institutional solo exhibition in Germany of renowned American photographer Catherine Opie. Known for her portraits, landscapes, and documentary work exploring identity, community, and American culture, Opie has been a defining voice in contemporary photography since the 1990s. The exhibition brings together key series from her three-decade career, including selected works from her ongoing practice. Opie's work is held in major collections worldwide including the Museum of Modern Art in New York and the Tate Modern in London. The Fridericianum, one of Europe's oldest public museums, was the main venue for documenta for decades and provides a stunning setting for this exhibition. The exhibition runs until July 19, 2026, with guided tours available Wednesdays at 18:00.

events.title: Dracula: A Comedy of Terrors — English Theatre Frankfurt
events.description: The English Theatre Frankfurt presents 'Dracula: A Comedy of Terrors', a side-splitting comedic adaptation of Bram Stoker's classic horror novel. This off-Broadway hit features a fast-paced, laugh-out-loud retelling where five actors play multiple roles in quick-changing hilarity. The production blends sharp wit, physical comedy, and theatrical ingenuity while remaining faithful to the spirit of the original story. The English Theatre, located in the heart of Frankfurt's banking district, is the largest English-language theatre in continental Europe. The play runs until July 5, 2026, with performances Tuesday through Saturday evenings. Pre-show dining packages are available at the theatre's restaurant, offering a complete evening out.
events.location: English Theatre Frankfurt, Gallusanlage 7, 60329 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Candlelight: Best of Coldplay — Capitol Theater Offenbach
events.description: The Candlelight concert series presents the best of Coldplay performed by a live string quartet in the intimate setting of the Capitol Theater in Offenbach. The venue is illuminated by hundreds of candles, creating a warm, romantic atmosphere perfect for enjoying Coldplay's greatest hits in a new way. The program includes 'Yellow', 'Fix You', 'Viva la Vida', 'A Sky Full of Stars', and other beloved songs, reimagined for classical instruments. The Capitol Theater, housed in a beautiful historic building that was once a synagogue, provides exceptional acoustics and a unique cultural atmosphere. Multiple performance times are available, with both early (19:00) and late (21:00) shows. Tickets start at approximately €30, with premium seating options available.
events.location: Capitol Theater Offenbach, Goethestraße 1-5, 63067 Offenbach am Main

events.title: Orscheler Sommer bewegt! — Sportprogramm
events.description: The 'Orscheler Sommer bewegt!' sports program offers approximately 25 free sports events across Oberursel, encouraging active participation for all ages. Activities include basketball tournaments, beach volleyball, outdoor yoga, skateboarding workshops, and guided bike tours through the Taunus hills. Professional instructors lead each activity, making them suitable for beginners and experienced participants alike. All equipment is provided free of charge — just show up in comfortable sportswear. The program runs from June through August, with events spread across different days and times to maximize accessibility. No registration is required for most activities; simply arrive at the designated meeting point at the scheduled time.

events.title: WELCOME____IN BETWEEN — Dirk Pleyer Kunstausstellung
events.description: The Kunstverein Friedberg presents 'WELCOME____IN BETWEEN', an exhibition by artist Dirk Pleyer exploring themes of landscape loss, longing, and the spaces between the familiar and the unknown. Pleyer's works combine painting, drawing, and installation to create immersive environments that question our relationship with the natural world. The exhibition is held at the Wetterau-Museum in Friedberg, a regional history museum that provides a fitting context for Pleyer's landscape-based work. The exhibition runs from May 23 to July 5, 2026, with opening hours Wednesday through Saturday 15:00-18:00 and Sunday 11:00-17:00. Admission is free, and a catalogue with essays accompanies the exhibition. This is a must-see for those interested in contemporary landscape art and environmental themes.

events.title: Hedwig Kruse-Geibel — Expressive Druckgrafik und Collagen
events.description: The Hessisches Landesmuseum Darmstadt presents the expressive paper works of Hedwig Kruse-Geibel (1895–1991) for the first time in this comprehensive exhibition. Held in the Karl-Freund-Galerie, the show features the graphic prints and collages of a nearly forgotten modernist artist. Kruse-Geibel's powerful, expressive works span much of the 20th century and offer a fresh perspective on German modernism from a female artist's viewpoint. The works reveal her mastery of various printmaking techniques including woodcut, etching, and lithography, often combined with collage elements. The exhibition runs from June 20 to September 27, 2026, with museum hours Tuesday through Sunday 10:00-17:00 and Wednesday until 20:00. A publication accompanies the exhibition with scholarly essays contextualizing her work within German art history.

events.title: Staatstheater Darmstadt: Lazarus — David Bowie Musical
events.description: David Bowie's extraordinary off-Broadway musical 'Lazarus' comes to the Staatstheater Darmstadt in a bold new production. The story follows an alien who crash-lands on Earth searching for water, weaving Bowie's iconic songs including 'Heroes', 'Life on Mars?', 'Changes', and 'Lazarus' into a surreal narrative. Director Sascha Hawemann's production transforms the theatre into a dreamlike journey between science fiction, pop music, and existential searching. The musical features a live band performing Bowie's classics alongside new compositions from his final album 'Blackstar'. Performances run through June and July with varied dates; check the website for the exact schedule. Tickets range from €20 to €65, with student and group discounts available.

events.title: GIFT — Tödliche Gaben: Natural History Exhibition Museum Wiesbaden
events.description: Museum Wiesbaden presents 'GIFT — Tödliche Gaben' (Poison — Deadly Gifts), a fascinating natural history exhibition exploring the world of poisons. From deadly animals and plants to toxic substances in human history, the exhibition reveals the thin line between healing and harm. Over 500 exhibits include venomous creatures, historical poison cabinets, forensic artifacts, and interactive displays. The exhibition combines natural history with cultural history, showing how poisons have been used in medicine, crime, and mythology. Family-friendly interactive stations let visitors test their knowledge about poisonous plants and animals in Germany. Open Tuesday through Sunday, also Wednesday until 20:00, the exhibition runs until April 4, 2027.

events.title: Georg Lührig — Ein Meister aus Dresden, Museum Wiesbaden
events.description: Museum Wiesbaden presents the first major retrospective of Dresden painter and graphic artist Georg Lührig (1868–1957), a master of Jugendstil and Symbolism. The exhibition showcases over 120 works from his mysterious, often dreamlike oeuvre that defined Dresden's art scene around 1900. Featuring paintings, drawings, and prints, the show brings this nearly forgotten artist back into the spotlight with loans from major German museums. Lührig's style combines elements of Art Nouveau, symbolism, and early expressionism, creating a unique visual language. The exhibition runs from May 22, 2026 to January 17, 2027, allowing ample time for multiple visits. A combined ticket with the 'Gift' exhibition is available for €16.

events.title: Rheingau Musik Festival: VOCES8 meets Chanticleer
events.description: Two of the world's finest vocal ensembles perform together in a rare joint concert as part of the 39th Rheingau Musik Festival. VOCES8 from the United Kingdom and Chanticleer from San Francisco present a cappella masterpieces spanning Renaissance polyphony to contemporary works. The evening is part of the festival's 'Spot on: United Kingdom' focus, celebrating British musical heritage. The concert takes place in the magnificent Friedrich-von-Thiersch-Saal at the Kurhaus Wiesbaden, renowned for its exceptional acoustics. A pre-concert introduction by the festival director offers insights into the program and historical context. Tickets range from €28 and include a complimentary glass of sparkling wine during intermission.

events.title: Stadttheater Gießen — Sommer Spielplan
events.description: The Stadttheater Gießen, one of Hessen's six major public theaters, presents its diverse summer program featuring drama, music theatre, dance, and concerts. The theater operates five divisions — drama, music theatre, dance, concerts, and youth theatre — ensuring a varied program for all tastes. The summer season includes both classic works and contemporary productions, performed by the theater's professional ensemble. The Stadttheater building itself is a historic Art Nouveau landmark in the heart of Gießen, providing an elegant cultural setting. Tickets start at just €12, with generous student and reduced-rate options available. Check the website for exact performance dates and titles during your visit period.

events.title: Rembrandt 1632 — Entstehung einer Marke, Schloss Wilhelmshöhe
events.description: Museum Schloss Wilhelmshöhe presents a landmark exhibition examining the pivotal year 1632 in Rembrandt's career, titled 'Rembrandt 1632 — Entstehung einer Marke' (Creation of a Brand). Featuring high-caliber international loans from museums worldwide, the exhibition shows how the young Rembrandt established his 'brand' through artistic experimentation and innovative techniques. Highlights include major paintings, etchings, and drawings from collections including the Rijksmuseum, the Louvre, and the National Gallery in London. The exhibition demonstrates how Rembrandt's distinctive style — dramatic chiaroscuro, psychological depth, and technical mastery — set him apart from contemporaries. The magnificent setting of Schloss Wilhelmshöhe, a UNESCO World Heritage site, provides an appropriate backdrop for this display of artistic genius. The exhibition runs until August 9, 2026, with audio guides available in German and English.

events.title: Freiluftkino Frankfurt — Open Air Cinema at the Main
events.description: The Freiluftkino Frankfurt transforms the banks of the Main River into an enchanting outdoor cinema venue for the summer season. Guests watch blockbuster films and classics on a large screen while sitting on deck chairs or blankets under the open sky. The program runs from late June through August and features a curated mix of international hits, German films, and family-friendly favorites. Snacks, popcorn, and cold drinks are available at the venue, and blankets can be rented on site. The atmospheric setting with Frankfurt's illuminated skyline in the background makes this a magical summer evening experience. Tickets are available online and at the box office; early arrival is recommended for best seating.

events.title: Orscheler Sommer — Open-Air-Kino Oberursel
events.description: The Orscheler Sommer in Oberursel presents free open-air cinema screenings at various locations across the city throughout the summer. Movies begin at dusk (approximately 21:30) at venues including the Erich-Kästner-Schule and Rushmoorpark, with blockbusters and family favorites on the programme. The 40th edition of the Orscheler Sommer runs from mid-June through September, featuring approximately 40 free events for the community. Bring your own blanket or camping chair, as seating is not provided, creating a relaxed picnic atmosphere. A selection of snacks and drinks is available for purchase, or you can bring your own picnic. In case of rain, screenings are cancelled — check the website for updates on the day.

events.title: Forty/Forty Saisonabschluss-Party — Centralstation Darmstadt
events.description: Centralstation Darmstadt hosts the 'Forty/Forty — Age is just a number' end-of-season party for those in their late 30s to late 40s. With DJs spinning a mix of 80s, 90s, and 2000s hits, this party provides a relaxed yet festive atmosphere in the unique setting of the historic Centralstation building. The venue, a converted historic power station, offers excellent acoustics and a spacious dance floor. Craft beer, wine, and cocktails are available from the bar throughout the night. The party is a popular end-of-season celebration for Darmstadt's cultural scene. Tickets range from €12 to €15 and are available in advance through the Centralstation website.

events.title: Summer Break Festival 2026 — Gießen
events.description: The Summer Break Festival is Gießen's premier electronic and hip-hop music festival, now in its fourth edition at the WM-Arena. Top acts including Felicia Bianco and Salvatore Mancuso headline across two stages, with a focus on cutting-edge electronic music and urban beats. The festival features multiple genre zones, art installations, and a dedicated chill-out area with lounge furniture and ambient music. Gourmet food trucks serve everything from vegan bowls to traditional German BBQ, with craft beer and cocktail bars throughout the venue. The festival runs June 26-27, with camping options available for those who want the full weekend experience. Tickets range from €49.90 for day passes to €79.90 for weekend passes with camping.

events.title: Flohmarkt Dreieich — Großer Trödelmarkt
events.description: The Flohmarkt Dreieich is one of the largest and most famous flea markets in the Rhine-Main region, held on the grounds around the Dreieichhalle. Hundreds of vendors offer an incredible variety of goods: antiques, vintage clothing, vinyl records, books, toys, electronics, and collectibles of every kind. Bargain hunters and collectors from across Hessen make the Saturday pilgrimage to find hidden treasures and one-of-a-kind items. The market sprawls across multiple areas including an indoor hall and outdoor fields, ensuring something for every taste and budget. Food vendors serve hearty German breakfasts, grilled sausages, coffee, and cakes throughout the day. Free entry and easy access by car (A3 exit Dreieich) or S-Bahn (S4 to Dreieich-Buchschlag, then bus OF-50).

events.title: Dietzenbach Culture Summer — Kultursommer
events.description: The Dietzenbach Kultursommer brings live music, theatre, and cultural events to venues across the city throughout the summer. The program features local bands, theatre groups, and artists presenting a diverse range of performances. Evening concerts at the Stadtpark provide a relaxed setting for enjoying music under the open sky. Food and refreshments are available from local providers and community organizations. The Kultursommer runs from June through August with events typically on weekends. Most events are free, making culture accessible to all residents of Dietzenbach and the surrounding area.

events.title: Sommerfest Rodgau — Bürgerpark
events.description: The Rodgau Sommerfest in the Bürgerpark is a family-friendly summer celebration featuring live bands, dance performances, and a festive program. Local musicians and cover bands perform on the main stage, with genres ranging from rock to pop to Schlager. Food stalls offer grilled specialties, salads, and refreshing beverages, with plenty of seating areas in the park. Children can enjoy pony rides, a petting zoo, and craft stations supervised by youth organizations. The festival atmosphere is relaxed and community-focused, attracting families from across the Kreis Offenbach region. Free entry and ample free parking make this an easy and affordable summer outing.

events.title: 25. Internationaler Keramikmarkt Hanau
events.description: The 25th International Ceramics Market in Hanau brings together over 40 master potters and ceramic artists from across Germany and Europe. Set in the beautiful Schlossgarten Philippsruhe, visitors can browse and purchase unique handmade ceramics ranging from functional tableware to sculptural art pieces. The biennial market is one of the oldest and most prestigious ceramics events in the region, attracting collectors and enthusiasts alike. Live throwing demonstrations allow visitors to watch potters at work and learn about wheel-throwing techniques. Children can try their hand at clay modeling in the dedicated workshop area, with expert guidance provided. Free entry to the market makes it an accessible and enjoyable day out for the whole family.

events.title: Wiesbadener Sommerrodelbahn — Erlebnispark Sommeraktion
events.description: The Wiesbadener Sommerrodelbahn summer action day offers half-price tickets for the city's famous summer toboggan run in the Neroberg park. The 1,200-meter-long track winds through the forest with panoramic views over Wiesbaden, providing thrilling downhill rides for all ages. The special summer action includes additional attractions such as a climbing wall, mini-golf, and a barbecue area. The Neroberg park itself features vineyards, the historic Nerobergbahn funicular, and the Russian Orthodox Church. The combination of adventure sports and the beautiful park setting makes this a perfect family summer day out. Half-price action day tickets €7 per ride or €20 for a day pass.

events.title: Hessisches Staatstheater: Così fan tutte — Mozart
events.description: Mozart's beloved opera buffa about love, fidelity, and the games people play is staged at the Hessisches Staatstheater Wiesbaden. Under the musical direction of Leo McFall and directed by Marie-Ève Signeyrole, this production features a talented ensemble including Lena Geiger as Fiordiligi and Jack Lee as Guglielmo. The opera is performed in Italian with German surtitles, making it accessible for all audiences. The Staatstheater's main stage provides an intimate setting that brings Mozart's sparkling score to life with the Hessian State Orchestra. Pre-opera introductory talks at 18:30 offer insights into the production's themes and staging concept. Tickets range from €15 to €85, with reduced prices for students.

events.title: Mainova IRONMAN European Championship Frankfurt
events.description: The Mainova IRONMAN European Championship is one of the world's most prestigious triathlon events, bringing thousands of athletes to Frankfurt for a 3.8km swim, 180km bike, and 42.2km run. The swim takes place in the Langener Waldsee, followed by a bike course through the Hessian countryside and a run along Frankfurt's iconic Mainufer. Spectators line the course at key points including the Römer and the finish line at the Festhalle, creating an incredible atmosphere. What makes this race special is that it serves as the European Championship qualifier for the IRONMAN World Championship in Kona, Hawaii. The event also features an expo, pasta party, and children's races throughout the weekend. Free to watch as a spectator, with grandstand tickets available for the finish line area. Expect road closures and increased public transport.
events.location: Festhalle Messe, Friedrich-Ebert-Anlage 1, 60308 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Flohmarkt Globus Baumarkt — Frankfurt Flea Market
events.description: The weekly flea market at the Globus Baumarkt in Frankfurt's east end is one of the city's most popular Sunday markets. Vendors offer an eclectic mix of antiques, vintage clothing, vinyl records, books, electronics, toys, household goods, and collectibles. Bargaining is expected and part of the fun, with prices often negotiable especially in the afternoon. The market attracts a diverse crowd of locals, tourists, and serious collectors looking for hidden treasures. Food stalls serve hearty German Bratwurst, coffee, and cakes to keep shoppers fueled. Free entry and accessible by U-Bahn (U4 to Schäfflestraße, 10-minute walk).
events.location: Globus Baumarkt, Hanauer Landstraße 500, 60386 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Roberto Juan Rodriguez — One World Music, Eschborn K
events.description: Cuban-American percussionist Roberto Juan Rodriguez brings his 'One World Music' project to the Eschborn K cultural venue. Rodriguez blends Afro-Cuban rhythms, Latin jazz, and world music into a vibrant, danceable fusion that transcends cultural boundaries. A master percussionist who has worked with artists including David Byrne and Grammy-winning ensembles, Rodriguez's performances are infectious and joyous. The afternoon concert is part of the Volksbildungswerk Eschborn's cultural program, offering world-class music in an intimate setting. The Eschborn K provides excellent acoustics and a welcoming atmosphere for this afternoon of global rhythms. Tickets are available via Eventim and at the door.

events.title: Annett Louisan — 22 Jahre Bohème, Gutshof Rettershof
events.description: Iconic German chanson singer Annett Louisan celebrates 22 years of her debut album 'Bohème' with a special open-air concert at the historic Gutshof Rettershof in Kelkheim. Known for her delicate, whispery voice and poetic lyrics, Louisan has been a defining figure in German pop chanson since her breakthrough in 2004. Her songs blend elements of chanson, pop, and jazz, creating an intimate and sophisticated musical world. The Gutshof Rettershof, a beautifully restored 16th-century estate, provides a charming courtyard setting for this summer evening concert. Part of the Rheingau Musik Festival and the Kelkheimer Kultursommer, this concert combines exceptional music with historic ambiance. Tickets are available via Frankfurt Ticket, with general admission seating on the courtyard.

events.title: 48. Interkulturelles Sommerfest Wiesbaden
events.description: Wiesbaden's annual multicultural summer festival on the Schlossplatz celebrates the city's diversity with music, dance, and cuisine from around the world. The 48th edition brings together migrant organizations, cultural associations, and community initiatives from over 30 nations. Visitors enjoy international food stalls offering specialties from Africa, Asia, Europe, and the Americas, all prepared by community cooks. Live performances on multiple stages feature traditional and contemporary music, dance troupes, and theater groups throughout the day. A children's program offers face painting, craft stations, and interactive games representing different cultures. Admission is free, making this one of Wiesbaden's most accessible and vibrant community celebrations.

events.title: Nassauischer Kunstverein: Barbara Proschak — Finissage
events.description: The finissage of Barbara Proschak's first comprehensive solo exhibition in Germany, 'Bewegte Ordnung' (Moving Order), at the Nassauischer Kunstverein Wiesbaden. The exhibition showcases 15 years of the artist's work, exploring the need for motifs and patterns in artistic creation through painting, drawing, and installation. The finissage includes a guided tour with director Lotte Dinse, offering deep insights into Proschak's creative process and thematic concerns. Works range from large-scale abstract compositions to intimate drawings, revealing the artist's meticulous approach to order and its disruption. The Nassauischer Kunstverein, founded in 1847, is one of Germany's oldest art associations, housed in a historic villa on Wilhelmstraße. Admission is €5 (reduced €3), and the exhibition's final day offers a last chance to see the works before they are disassembled.

events.title: Gregor Meyle & Sophia - Doppelkonzert
events.description: Im Rahmen des Schlosshof Open Air Butzbach treten Gregor Meyle und SOPHIA gemeinsam am 28. Juni 2026 im historischen Schlosshof von Butzbach auf. Die beiden deutschen Pop-Künstler verbinden ihre Musikstile für einen unvergesslichen Sommerabend. Die einzigartige Atmosphäre des Schlosshofs mit historischer Kulisse bildet den perfekten Rahmen. Das Doppelkonzert wird von HIT RADIO FFH präsentiert.

events.title: hr-Sinfonieorchester: Karneval der Tiere
events.description: Im Rahmen der 75. Bad Hersfelder Festspiele gastiert das hr-Sinfonieorchester Frankfurt unter der Leitung von Chefdirigent Alain Altinoglu in der eindrucksvollen Stiftsruine. Auf dem Programm steht Saint-Saens' 'Karneval der Tiere', ein heiteres Werk, das sich perfekt als Familienkonzert eignet. Nach langer Pause kehrt das Orchester damit zu den Festspielen zurück und lädt Jung und Alt zu einem unterhaltsamen Nachmittag ein. Der Kartenvorverkauf begann am 3. November 2025.
events.location: Stiftsruine Bad Hersfeld, Am Markt 1, 36251 Bad Hersfeld

events.title: Opernplatz Sommerfest — Frankfurt
events.description: The Opernplatz in Frankfurt transforms into a vibrant summer meeting point with outdoor dining, live music, and a festive atmosphere. Upscale restaurants around the square set up outdoor terraces, offering everything from Italian cuisine to sushi to classic Frankfurter specialties. Live jazz, soul, and acoustic performances create a sophisticated ambiance on the square throughout the evening. The Alte Oper, illuminated against the night sky, provides a stunning architectural backdrop. The relaxed, cosmopolitan atmosphere attracts a mix of professionals, tourists, and locals enjoying the warm summer evenings. Free to attend — simply find a table at one of the restaurants or grab a drink from the pop-up bars.

events.title: St. Bardo-Treff
events.description: Am 1. Juli 2026 laedt die katholische Pfarrgruppe Karben zum St. Bardo-Treff ins Gemeindehaus in Petterweil ein. Ab 14:30 Uhr sind alle zu einem gemuetlichen Nachmittag mit Kaffee und Kuchen willkommen. Der St. Bardo-Treff ist ein regelmässiges Angebot der Kirchengemeinde zur Begegnung und zum Austausch. Die Veranstaltung ist kostenfrei und steht allen offen.
events.location: Kath. Gemeindehaus St. Bardo, Vilbeler Str. 14, 61184 Karben-Petterweil

events.title: Bad Vilbel Open Air — Sommerklassiker im Freiluftkino
events.description: The Bad Vilbel Open Air cinema presents classic and contemporary films on a large outdoor screen in the Kurpark. The season runs through the summer with screenings at dusk, providing a magical movie experience under the stars. The program includes a mix of German and international films, family favorites, and art-house cinema. Bring blankets, cushions, and picnic supplies for maximum comfort, or enjoy snacks from the on-site concession stand. The Kurpark setting with its historic spa architecture creates a unique and charming cinema atmosphere. Tickets are available at the box office or online, with regular screenings from June through September.

events.title: Königstein Sommerkonzert — Burg Open Air
events.description: The Königstein Sommerkonzert takes place in the courtyard of the majestic Burg Königstein, one of the largest castle ruins in Germany. The concert features classical and popular works performed by regional orchestras and ensembles, with the castle walls providing spectacular natural acoustics. Audiences are seated in the historic courtyard, surrounded by medieval stone walls and overlooking the Taunus landscape. The program typically includes a mix of overtures, arias, and popular classics, appealing to both classical connoisseurs and newcomers. Pre-concert guided tours of the castle are offered, explaining the fortress's 500-year history. Tickets are available through the Königstein tourist office, with the castle café open before the concert and during intermission.

events.title: 76. Darmstädter Heinerfest
events.description: One of Germany's most vibrant inner-city festivals, the 76th Heinerfest transforms Darmstadt's city center into a massive festival ground. With over 700,000 visitors expected across five days, the festival features thrilling rides, game booths, live music stages, and culinary specialties. The area between the Schloss and Karolinenplatz becomes a pedestrian-only celebration zone with over 100 attractions and food stands. The festival is named after the local nickname 'Heiner' for Darmstadt residents, and the tradition dates back to 1951. Highlights include the fireworks display on Saturday night, the Sunday brunch with live jazz, and the traditional Heinerfest parade. Entry is free, with individual attractions costing €2-5 per ride; cash is recommended as not all vendors accept cards.

events.title: Izo FitzRoy — Sommerreihe 2026, Trinkkuranlage Bad Nauheim
events.description: British-American singer-songwriter Izo FitzRoy opens the Bad Nauheim Sommerreihe 2026 with her powerful blend of soul, blues, gospel, and jazz. Her rich, commanding voice and heartfelt songwriting have earned comparisons to Aretha Franklin and Mavis Staples. The concert takes place at the historic Trinkkuranlage, an iconic open-air stage in Bad Nauheim's park, surrounded by Art Nouveau architecture. The Sommerreihe is Bad Nauheim's premier summer concert series, attracting top international and German artists to this historic spa town. Audiences are encouraged to bring blankets and arrive early to secure good spots on the lawn. Tickets start at €24 and are available through the Bad Nauheim cultural office and Eventim.

events.title: Licht und Schatten — Offenbacher Freizeitkünstler Vernissage
events.description: The 'Licht und Schatten' (Light and Shadow) exhibition by the Offenbacher Freizeitkünstler (Offenbach Leisure Artists) opens with a festive vernissage. Local amateur and semi-professional artists present their latest works exploring the themes of light and shadow in painting, photography, and mixed media. The exhibition showcases the vibrant local art scene and provides a platform for creative talent in Offenbach. The vernissage includes musical accompaniment and refreshments, creating a convivial atmosphere for art enthusiasts and newcomers alike. The exhibition is held at the Stadtkirchenarbeit Offenbach, a community-focused cultural venue in the city center. Admission is free, and all works are available for purchase.

events.title: Mädelsabend - Wild, Wild West!
events.description: Die Andreas GmbH in Dietzenbach veranstaltet am 3. Juli 2026 einen besonderen Mädelsabend unter dem Motto 'Wild, Wild West!' für Frauen. Der Abend bietet Musik, Drinks, kulinarische Spezialitäten und Einkaufsmöglichkeiten im Wild-West-Style. Die Location ist bekannt für ihr ausgefallenes Dekorationssortiment. Karten sind im Vorverkauf bei Eventbrite erhältlich.

events.title: Hugenottenmarkt 2026
events.description: Der traditionelle Hugenottenmarkt findet vom 3. bis 5. Juli 2026 im Zentrum Friedrichsdorfs statt. Das Strassenfest bietet ein Bühnenprogramm auf zwei Bühnen mit Live-Musik, eine Kunsthandwerksmeile sowie vielfältige Speisen und Getränke. Rund 60 Stände präsentieren ihr Angebot. Der Eintritt zu diesem von HUGO e.V. organisierten Fest ist kostenfrei.
events.location: Innenstadt Friedrichsdorf, Landgrafenplatz bis Rathausplatz, 61381 Friedrichsdorf

events.title: Friedrichsdorf Sommerfest — Philipp-Reis-Park
events.description: The Friedrichsdorf Sommerfest in the Philipp-Reis-Park celebrates the town's history as the birthplace of telephone inventor Philipp Reis. Live music, dance performances, and a children's entertainment program fill the park with festive energy throughout the afternoon and evening. International food stalls reflect Friedrichsdorf's historical ties to Huguenot settlers, with French-inspired dishes alongside German classics. A special historical exhibition at the Philipp Reis Museum is open during the festival, showcasing the invention of the telephone. The park's pond, playgrounds, and green spaces provide ample room for families to relax and enjoy the summer weather. Free entry with free parking available at the nearby Rathaus.

events.title: Königsteiner Event Sommer 2026 – Open-Air-Kultur
events.description: Der Königsteiner Event Sommer 2026 eröffnet die Sommersaison mit einem abwechslungsreichen Open-Air-Programm in der idyllischen Hubert-Faßbender-Anlage. Besucher erwartet ein Mix aus Live-Musik, Kleinkunst und sommerlicher Atmosphäre bei freiem Eintritt. Die Konzertreihe bietet für jeden Geschmack etwas – von Jazz und Rock über Pop bis hin zu Familienprogrammen. Eine Weinbar und Sitzgelegenheiten unter freiem Himmel laden zum entspannten Verweilen ein. Das vollständige Programm liegt in der Kur- und Stadtinformation aus und ist online abrufbar.

events.title: SKELPT — Fiery Scots Folk, Rheingau Musik Festival
events.description: SKELPT, a high-energy Scottish folk band, brings their fiery blend of bagpipes, fiddle, and driving rhythms to the Gutshof Rettershof in Kelkheim. Part of the prestigious Rheingau Musik Festival, the concert showcases traditional and contemporary Scottish folk music at its most exhilarating. The band's virtuosic instrumentals and powerful vocals have earned them a devoted following across Europe's folk festival circuit. The historic Gutshof Rettershof courtyard provides an atmospheric setting with its centuries-old architecture and starry summer sky. The Rheingau Musik Festival runs from June 20 to September 5, 2026, with this year's focus on the United Kingdom. Tickets are available through the Rheingau Musik Festival pre-sale and at the gate if not sold out.

events.title: 9. Rüsselsheimer WINE-fest
events.description: The 9th Rüsselsheimer WINE-fest brings over 100 wines from the Rheingau, Rheinhessen, and Pfalz wine regions to the beautiful Verna-Park (Stadtpark). Local vintners present their finest Rieslings, Spätburgunders, and Silvaners for tasting and purchase by the glass or bottle. Sommelier-led tasting sessions help visitors discover the nuances of different grape varieties and vintages. Live music from local bands and solo musicians creates a relaxed atmosphere throughout the evenings. Regional cheese and charcuterie boards, Flammkuchen, and other wine-friendly foods are available from food stalls. Entry is free, with a deposit system for wine glasses; the festival runs July 3-5.

events.title: 27. Marburger Nachtmarathon
events.description: The 27th Marburg Night Marathon is the region's largest running event, offering a full marathon, half marathon, and 4-person relay through the historic streets of Marburg. The unique nighttime start at 19:00 allows runners to experience the city's medieval old town, the Lahn riverbanks, and the hilltop castle illuminated after dark. The course features challenging elevation changes as it climbs through Marburg's famous Oberstadt (upper town), rewarding runners with spectacular views. Music stations and cheering crowds line the route, creating a festive atmosphere throughout the night. All finishers receive a commemorative medal and a finisher's T-shirt, with awards for the top three in each age category. Registration is available online, with prices ranging from €25 for the half marathon to €50 for the full marathon.

events.title: Öffentliche Stadtführung — Barockstadt Fulda
events.description: Discover the beauty and history of Fulda's Baroque old town with a guided walking tour led by certified city guides. The tour covers the magnificent Fulda Cathedral (Dom), the Stadtschloss (city palace), the historic old town with its half-timbered houses, and the Orangerie gardens. Guides share fascinating stories about Fulda's role as a center of the Baroque, its founding by Saint Boniface, and its development through the centuries. The tour lasts approximately two hours and covers about 2km on mostly flat, walkable paths. Tours are available daily at 11:00 and 14:00 in German, with English tours available on request. Cost is €10-15 per person, with children under 12 free; no reservation required for regular tours.

events.title: Rembrandt 1632 — Kuratorführung auf Englisch
events.description: A special English-language curator's tour of the landmark 'Rembrandt 1632 — Entstehung einer Marke' exhibition at Museum Schloss Wilhelmshöhe. The exhibition curator leads visitors through the pivotal year when Rembrandt established his artistic brand, explaining the paintings, etchings, and drawings on loan from international museums. The tour provides in-depth insights into Rembrandt's innovative techniques, his marketing strategies, and the artistic context of the Dutch Golden Age. Participants gain exclusive access to behind-the-scenes stories about the loans, conservation work, and exhibition design. The tour lasts approximately 90 minutes and includes time for questions. Tickets include museum admission and are limited to 20 participants to ensure an intimate experience.

events.title: Eschwege Stadtfest — Altstadtfest
events.description: The Eschwege Altstadtfest transforms the historic old town of this charming Werra River city into a vibrant festival zone. Live music stages feature local bands playing rock, pop, and folk, while the streets fill with food and drink stalls. The festival showcases Eschwege's historic half-timbered architecture, with the Marktplatz serving as the central hub. Traditional Hessian specialties and local wines are available from venders throughout the old town. A children's program includes games, face painting, and a mini train ride through the festival area. Free entry makes this community celebration accessible to all visitors.

events.title: Stadtteilfest Zeppelinheim — Neu-Isenburg
events.description: The Stadtteilfest Zeppelinheim is a community festival in the Zeppelinheim district of Neu-Isenburg, celebrating the area's unique Zeppelin aviation history. The festival features live music, food stalls, a flea market, and children's activities including a bouncy castle and face painting. Local vereine and community groups operate the food and drink stands, offering traditional German fare at reasonable prices. The Zeppelin Museum, dedicated to the history of airship travel, offers special opening hours and tours during the festival. The festival provides a wonderful opportunity to experience local community spirit in this historic aviation district. Free entry and free parking available near the festival grounds.

events.title: Langen Sommerfest — Stadtpark
events.description: The Langen Sommerfest is the city's annual summer celebration in the Stadtpark, featuring live music, food stalls, and family activities. Local bands and musicians perform on the park stage throughout the day, covering rock, pop, jazz, and folk. Food and drink stalls operated by local vereine offer everything from grilled specialties to homemade cakes. Children's activities include face painting, bouncy castles, and craft stations supervised by youth workers. The festival creates a relaxed community atmosphere where neighbors and families gather to celebrate summer in the park. Entry is free, making it an accessible and enjoyable day out for all ages.

events.title: Kronberg Kultursommer — Opel-Zoo Familienfest
events.description: The Kronberg Kultursommer features a special Familienfest (Family Festival) at the Opel-Zoo, combining wildlife education with summer fun. Special animal feeding demonstrations, keeper talks, and behind-the-scenes tours give visitors unique insights into the zoo's work. Children can enjoy face painting, treasure hunts, craft stations, and pony rides in the zoo's spacious park grounds. Live music performances add to the festive atmosphere, with local bands playing family-friendly music throughout the day. The Opel-Zoo is home to over 1,500 animals across 45 hectares and is one of Hessen's most popular family destinations. Regular zoo admission applies (€11-16), with special activity stations included in the ticket price.
events.location: Opel-Zoo Kronberg, Am Opel-Zoo 2, 61476 Kronberg im Taunus

events.title: Mörfelden-Walldorf Bürgerfest — Rathausplatz
events.description: The Mörfelden-Walldorf Bürgerfest (Citizens' Festival) on the Rathausplatz is the twin city's annual community celebration. Live bands perform on the main stage throughout the day, offering a mix of rock, pop, and traditional music. Food and drink stalls operated by local clubs and associations serve regional specialties and international dishes. A dedicated children's area features a bouncy castle, face painting, and creative workshops. The festival celebrates community spirit and brings together residents from both the Mörfelden and Walldorf districts. Free entry with free parking at the Rathaus and nearby Bürgerpark.

events.title: Kronberger Sommer 2026 – StadtStrand am Berliner Platz
events.description: Sonne, Sand und Sommerfeeling mitten in Kronberg! Vom 27. Juni bis 2. August verwandelt sich der Berliner Platz in eine urbane Strand-Oase mit dem beliebten StadtStrand, gemütlichen Sommerliegen, einer Boulebahn und einem abwechslungsreichen Programm. Besucher können hier bei erfrischenden Getränken und Snacks entspannen, während Live-Musik und kulturelle Darbietungen für Unterhaltung sorgen. Der Eintritt ist frei, und die Strandatmosphäre lädt zum Verweilen und Genießen ein. Präsentiert vom Stadtmarketing Kronberg in Zusammenarbeit mit lokalen Partnern, ist dies der perfekte Ort für einen sommerlichen Tag mit Familie und Freunden.

events.title: Karben Sommerfest — Bürgerpark Klein-Karben
events.description: The Karben Sommerfest in the Bürgerpark Klein-Karben is the city's annual community celebration with live music, food, and family activities. Local vereine and organizations operate food and drink stalls offering grilled specialties, homemade cakes, and refreshing beverages. Live bands perform on the park stage, covering rock, pop, and traditional German Schlager music. Children's entertainment includes a bouncy castle, face painting, and craft stations supervised by youth workers. The relaxed park atmosphere makes it a perfect summer outing for families from Karben and the surrounding Wetterau region. Free entry, with plenty of free parking available near the park.

events.title: KreisStadtSommer 2026 — Hofheim am Taunus
events.description: The KreisStadtSommer is Hofheim's premier summer festival, featuring approximately 65 events across the city including concerts, theatre, poetry slams, and readings. The program kicks off July 2-4 with performances at ShowSpielhaus and a matinee by the music school. Live music spans rock, pop, jazz, and classical genres, with performances at various venues throughout the city. The festival runs through September 30, with event-specific scheduling — check the website for exact dates and times of individual events. Most events are free, with selected concerts and theatre performances carrying a small admission fee of €5-15. The KreisStadtSommer is organized by the city of Hofheim's cultural department and has been a summer tradition for over two decades.

events.title: Historische Stadtführung durch Grünberg
events.description: Stadtführer Werner Faust nimmt Besucher mit auf eine Reise in die Geschichte der Stadt Grünberg mit ihren Klosteranlagen und Fachwerkhäusern. Der Rundgang durch die historische Altstadt zeigt, wie Grünberg im Mittelalter aussah. Die Führung startet am Marktplatz und dauert etwa 90 Minuten. Grünberg blickt auf eine über 800-jährige Geschichte zurueck.

events.title: Offene Altstadtführung inkl. Rathausbesichtigung
events.description: Jeden Samstag um 11:00 Uhr bietet das Tourist Center Alsfeld eine offene Altstadtführung mit Rathausbesichtigung an. Die Gäste erfahren Wissenswertes und Überraschendes über die Geschichte der Stadt Alsfeld, ihrer prachtvollen Fachwerkhäuser und historischen Plätze. Vom weltbekannten Rathaus über die Walpurgiskirche bis zu den vielen kleinen schmucken Gassen führt der Rundgang. Die Führung dauert etwa 90 Minuten und kostet 7 Euro pro Person. Von Mai bis Oktober gibt es zusätzlich sonntags um 14:00 Uhr eine weitere offene Altstadtführung.

events.title: Sistergold - LuftMaschen (Burgfestspiele)
events.description: Die preisgekrönte A-cappella-Gruppe Sistergold gastiert am 5. Juli 2026 bei den Burgfestspielen Dreieichenhain im idyllischen Burggarten der Burg Hayn. Die fuenf Saengerinnen begeistern mit virtuosem Gesang, humorvollen Texten und mitreissender Buehnenpraesenz. Die Burgfestspiele bieten vom 24. Juni bis 9. August 2026 ein facettenreiches Programm. Die historische Open-Air-Kulisse des Burggartens schafft eine besondere Atmosphaere.

events.title: Usingen Altstadtflohmarkt
events.description: The Usingen Altstadtflohmarkt (Old Town Flea Market) transforms the historic half-timbered old town into a massive treasure hunt every first Sunday of the month. Over 100 private vendors set up stalls throughout the picturesque streets of Usingen's medieval center, selling antiques, vintage items, books, records, and household goods. The charming setting of half-timbered houses and cobblestone streets makes browsing a pleasure in itself. The market attracts visitors from across the Taunus region looking for unique finds and second-hand bargains. Coffee and cake stalls operated by local vereine provide refreshments throughout the morning. Free entry and free parking available at the Rathaus parking lot.

events.title: Schloss Sickendorf Antik- & Spezialmarkt
events.description: Der beliebte Antik- & Spezialmarkt auf Schloss Sickendorf verwandelt den malerischen Schlosspark in ein Paradies für Schatzsucher und Liebhaber ausgefallener Raritäten. Rund 50 Händler bieten Antiquitäten, Vintage-Möbel, Sammlerstücke, Kunsthandwerk und kulinarische Spezialitäten aus der Region an. Das historische Schlossensemble mit seinem weitläufigen Park schafft eine besondere Atmosphäre für einen entspannten Sonntagsausflug. Parkplätze stehen kostenfrei zur Verfügung, und für das leibliche Wohl ist mit regionalen Köstlichkeiten gesorgt. Der Markt findet mehrmals jährlich statt und lockt Besucher aus ganz Hessen an.

events.title: Rodgauer Weinfest auf dem Puiseauxplatz
events.description: Das Rodgauer Weinfest verwandelt den Puiseauxplatz in Nieder-Roden in eine festliche Oase für Weinliebhaber und Genießer. Vom 8. bis 20. Juli 2026 laden Winzer aus Rheinhessen und der Region täglich ab 17 Uhr zur Verkostung erlesener Weine und Sekte ein. Begleitend sorgt ein abwechslungsreiches Unterhaltungsprogramm mit Livemusik für eine ausgelassene Stimmung. Die Besucher können an gemütlichen Stehtischen verweilen und neben den Weinspezialitäten auch kulinarische Köstlichkeiten genießen. Der Puiseauxplatz im Herzen Nieder-Rodens bietet mit seinem Brunnen und den umliegenden Fachwerkhäusern eine charmante Kulisse für dieses sommerliche Genuss-Event.

events.title: Jazz im Palmengarten — Open Air Jazz Concert
events.description: The beloved 'Jazz im Palmengarten' series returns to Frankfurt's famous botanical gardens for another season of world-class open-air jazz. Every Thursday evening from July through August, the Palmengarten's lush greenery provides a stunning natural amphitheater for live jazz performances. The program features a mix of international jazz stars and rising German talents, spanning traditional jazz, fusion, Latin, and contemporary styles. Visitors are welcome to bring picnic baskets and blankets, or enjoy food and wine from the garden's restaurant. The concerts begin at sunset, with the garden's exotic plants and illuminated greenhouses creating a magical atmosphere. Tickets include garden admission and are available in advance or at the gate, weather permitting.
events.location: Palmengarten Frankfurt, Siesmayerstraße 61, 60323 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Till Brönner & Trio — Sommerreihe Bad Nauheim
events.description: World-renowned German trumpeter Till Brönner and his trio bring their virtuosic jazz to the Trinkkuranlage in Bad Nauheim. Brönner, one of Europe's most successful jazz musicians, blends smooth jazz, bossa nova, and contemporary sounds with his distinctive warm trumpet tone. His trio's interplay and improvisation are hallmarks of their live performances, creating a captivating musical conversation. The historic Trinkkuranlage, with its Art Nouveau architecture and park setting, provides an elegant backdrop for this summer evening concert. This concert is part of the Bad Nauheim Sommerreihe, a summer concert series featuring international and German artists. Tickets start at €37.70 and are available through Eventim and the Bad Nauheim cultural office.

events.title: OPEN DOORS Festival 2026 – 34. Musikspektakel
events.description: Das OPEN DOORS Festival verwandelt Neu-Isenburg drei Tage lang in eine große Festival-Kommune mit über 50 Bands auf drei Bühnen. Vom 10. bis 12. Juli 2026 präsentiert das 34. Musikspektakel eine bunte Mischung aus Rock, Pop, Jazz und Independent-Musik auf der Frankfurter Straße und in angrenzenden Locations. Der Eintritt zu allen Konzerten ist frei – ein einzigartiges Konzept, das Musikliebhaber aus der gesamten Rhein-Main-Region anzieht. Neben den musikalischen Highlights sorgen gastronomische Stände und eine ausgelassene Festival-Atmosphäre für unvergessliche Sommerabende. Das Festival ist eines der größten kostenlosen Musikereignisse in Hessen.

events.title: Bad Homburger Sommer — Open Air Kulturfestival (40. Auflage)
events.description: The 40th edition of the Bad Homburger Sommer is a three-week open-air cultural festival featuring approximately 50 events across the spa town. The program includes concerts spanning rock, pop, jazz, and classical, theatre performances, children's shows, silent disco, and open-air cinema. Events take place at multiple venues including the Kurpark, Kurhausgarten, and various squares throughout the city. Most events are free, with selected concerts carrying a modest admission fee of €5-25. The festival runs from July 10 through August 1, 2026, making it a central part of Bad Homburg's summer season. The Kurpark setting, with its historic buildings and manicured gardens, provides a beautiful backdrop for evening performances.
events.location: Kurpark & various venues, 61348 Bad Homburg vor der Höhe

events.title: Mark Forster — Sommer Shows 2026, Friedberg Open Air
events.description: German pop superstar Mark Forster performs at the Friedberg Open Air on the Seewiese, bringing his chart-topping hits to the Wetterau region. With songs like 'Au Revoir', 'Chöre', 'Sowieso', and 'Flash mich', Forster has become one of Germany's most successful pop artists of the past decade. His live shows are known for their infectious energy, singalong moments, and warm connection with the audience. The Seewiese provides a beautiful natural amphitheater setting with the lake creating a scenic backdrop for the evening. This is part of a three-concert weekend at the Seewiese, with the 90s Super Show (July 11) and Roland Kaiser (July 12) following. Tickets start at €69.95, with VIP packages including premium seating and catering available.

events.title: Butzbach Altstadtfest — Historisches Stadtfest
events.description: The Butzbach Altstadtfest celebrates the city's rich history in the beautifully preserved medieval old town with its landmark 'Haus zum Löwen'. Live music stages featuring local and regional bands are set up in the historic Marktplatz and surrounding streets. Food and drink stalls offer traditional Hessian specialties including Handkäse mit Musik, Grüne Soße, and locally brewed beers. Historical walking tours led by costumed guides explore Butzbach's history from Roman times through the Middle Ages. Children's entertainment includes puppet shows, face painting, and old-fashioned carnival games. Free entry makes this historic city festival accessible to all visitors from the Wetterau region.

events.title: 3 Tage Marburg — Stadtfest mit Drachenbootrennen
events.description: '3 Tage Marburg' (3 Days of Marburg) is Mittelhessen's largest city festival, transforming the entire city center into a vibrant celebration zone. Multiple music stages feature rock, pop, jazz, and folk performances, alongside DJ sets and dance floors. The highlight is the INNEXIS Dragon Boat Cup, where 64 teams race traditional dragon boats on the Lahn River in a spectacular display of teamwork and color. Food stalls from local vereine and restaurants offer everything from Hessian specialties to international cuisine at reasonable prices. A dedicated children's area provides face painting, bouncy castles, and craft activities throughout the weekend. The festival runs July 10-12 with free entry, making it a fantastic and affordable weekend experience for all ages.

events.title: Alsfields Altstadtfest — Fachwerk & Genuss
events.description: Alsfeld, famous for its exceptionally well-preserved half-timbered old town, hosts its annual Altstadtfest celebrating its UNESCO-listed medieval architecture. The festival spreads across the historic Marktplatz with the stunning Renaissance Town Hall and surrounding half-timbered houses as a backdrop. Live folk and pop music, traditional dance performances, and guided history tours entertain visitors throughout the weekend. Regional food specialties from the Vogelsberg region include hearty dishes, local cheeses, and wines from the Hessische Bergstraße. Artisan stalls offer handcrafted products from local makers, including pottery, textiles, and woodcarvings. Free entry and a charming historical atmosphere make this one of Oberhessen's most picturesque summer festivals.

events.title: Christone 'Kingfish' Ingram — Kulturzelt Kassel
events.description: Grammy-nominated American blues prodigy Christone 'Kingfish' Ingram brings his electrifying guitar and soulful voice to the Kulturzelt Kassel. Since his debut album 'Kingfish', he has been hailed as the future of blues music, drawing comparisons to legends like B.B. King and Buddy Guy. At just 27 years old, he has already shared stages with icons including Buddy Guy and earned worldwide critical acclaim. His live shows are breathtaking displays of virtuosic guitar work, deep Southern soul, and raw emotional power. The intimate tent setting of the Kulturzelt provides an ideal frame for his larger-than-life performance. This is a must-see for blues fans and anyone who appreciates exceptional musical talent.
events.location: Kulturzelt Kassel, Fuldaaue (An der Drahtbrücke), 34131 Kassel

events.title: Witzenhausen Sommertreiben — Stadtfest
events.description: The Witzenhausen Sommertreiben is the city's annual summer festival celebrating the cherry-growing capital of Hessen. Local fruit growers present their finest cherries and cherry products, from fresh fruit to jams, juices, and cherry liqueur. Live music, dance performances, and a small fun fair create a festive atmosphere in the old town. Food stalls offer regional specialties with a cherry twist, including cherry cake, cherry beer, and cherry-glazed grilled dishes. Guided walks through the surrounding cherry orchards are offered, explaining the region's cherry-growing traditions. Free entry and a welcoming community atmosphere make this a delightful summer destination.

events.title: Frankfurt Comic & Cosplay Convention — Messe Frankfurt
events.description: The Frankfurt Comic & Cosplay Convention at Messe Frankfurt brings together comic fans, cosplayers, and pop culture enthusiasts for a weekend of celebration. Artist Alley features over 100 comic artists, illustrators, and printmakers selling original artwork, prints, and commissions. The cosplay competition showcases incredible handmade costumes with categories for craftsmanship, performance, and group entries. Panels and workshops cover comic drawing techniques, storytelling, cosplay prop-making, and the business of independent publishing. The vendor hall offers comics, manga, figurines, apparel, and collectibles from major publishers and independent creators alike. Day passes range from €15-25, with weekend passes available for dedicated fans.
events.location: Messe Frankfurt, Ludwig-Erhard-Anlage 1, 60327 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: En Vogue - An Evening with En Vogue
events.description: En Vogue, eine der erfolgreichsten Female-Vocal-Groups der Musikgeschichte, gastiert am 11. Juli 2026 in der VILCO Stadthalle Bad Vilbel. Die Gruppe feierte mit Hits wie 'Hold On' und 'Free Your Mind' weltweit Erfolge. Das Konzert verspricht einen Abend voller Soul, R&B und Pop-Klassiker. Der Auftritt ist Teil ihrer 'An Evening with En Vogue'-Tour 2026.
events.location: VILCO Stadthalle Bad Vilbel, Niddaplatz 1, 61118 Bad Vilbel

events.title: Handkäs-Cup 2026 – Segelregatta auf dem Langener Waldsee
events.description: Der Handkäs-Cup ist eine traditionelle Segelregatta für die Bootsklasse 470er, die vom Wassersportverein Langen (WSVL) auf dem Langener Waldsee ausgerichtet wird. Segler aus der gesamten Region treten an diesem sportlichen Wochenende gegeneinander an und kämpfen um den begehrten Handkäs-Pokal. Der Langener Waldsee, mit 89 Hektar der größte Badesee im Rhein-Main-Gebiet, bietet eine malerische Kulisse für dieses spannende Sportereignis. Zuschauer können die Regatta vom Ufer aus verfolgen und die maritime Atmosphäre genießen. Die Teilnahme ist für registrierte Segler kostenpflichtig, der Eintritt für Zuschauer ist frei.

events.title: Kultur im Sommer 2026 — Rüsselsheim
events.description: 'Kultur im Sommer' (Culture in Summer) is Rüsselsheim's outdoor cultural festival at the Theatervorplatz am Treff. The program features concerts, theatre performances, dance shows, and workshops organized by Theater Rüsselsheim. Local and regional artists present a diverse program spanning genres from jazz to world music, contemporary dance to classical theatre. The festival runs from July 11-22, 2026, creating a vibrant cultural hub in the heart of the city. Many events are free, with selected performances carrying a small admission fee of €10-25. The open-air setting encourages relaxed summer evenings of cultural discovery, with food and drink available.
events.location: Theatervorplatz am Treff, 65428 Rüsselsheim am Main

events.title: 90s Super Show — Hessens größte 90er Party
events.description: Europe's biggest 90s nostalgia show comes to the Friedberg Open Air on the Seewiese, featuring an all-star lineup of 90s pop icons. Performers include Oli P., Caught In the Act, Rednex, and Aquagen, bringing back the biggest hits of the 1990s. Up to 13,000 visitors are expected for this massive open-air party presented by Hit Radio FFH. The show covers Eurodance, pop, Schlager, and everything in between, with costume contests and crowd participation throughout. The Seewiese venue features multiple bar areas, food trucks, and a large dance floor in front of the main stage. Tickets start at €39.90 and are available through the Friedberg Open Air website and Eventim.

events.title: SommerFieber Open Air 2026 – Festival im Schlossgarten
events.description: Das SommerFieber Open Air 2026 verwandelt die Open-Air-Arena im Schlossgarten Usingen in eine bunte Festival-Location mit Live-Acts, guter Musik und ausgelassener Sommerstimmung. Das Line-up umfasst Buffalo & Wallace, Hyperboat Music, DJ Rudi und Caro Marija, die für einen unvergesslichen Sommertag sorgen. Einlass ist ab 16:00 Uhr, das Programm beginnt um 17:00 Uhr. Tickets sind im Vorverkauf für 12 Euro erhältlich. Der historische Schlossgarten bietet mit seinen alten Bäumen und der malerischen Kulisse des Usinger Schlosses eine traumhafte Atmosphäre für dieses Open-Air-Event. Für Verpflegung mit kühlen Getränken und Snacks ist gesorgt.

events.title: Hessenbühne Open Air: Michael Schulte & Zoe Wees
events.description: A star-studded open-air concert celebrating 80 years of Hessen on the Hessenbühne in Wiesbaden's beautiful Kurpark. German pop sensation Michael Schulte, who represented Germany at the Eurovision Song Contest, headlines the evening with his warm, soulful voice. Powerhouse vocalist Zoe Wees, known for her international hit 'Control', and singer-songwriter Anne Mosters also perform. The concert is part of the Rheingau Musik Festival's special '80 Jahre Hessen' series, featuring top German artists. The Kurpark's open-air stage provides a picturesque setting with centuries-old trees and manicured gardens. Audiences are welcome to bring blankets and picnic baskets or order from the gourmet food vendors on site.
events.location: Open-Air-Bühne im Kurpark Wiesbaden, Kurpark, 65189 Wiesbaden

events.title: Spass mit Brass – Wetzlarer Festspiele 2026
events.description: Im Rahmen der 73. Wetzlarer Festspiele präsentiert 'Spass mit Brass' ein mitreißendes Open-Air-Konzert im Rosengärtchen, einer malerischen Parkanlage in der Wetzlarer Altstadt. Blasmusik vom Feinsten, gepaart mit Humor und Unterhaltung, garantiert einen heiteren Sommerabend unter freiem Himmel. Die Wetzlarer Festspiele bieten von Juni bis August ein vielfältiges Programm mit Theater, Musik und Kabarett an verschiedenen Spielorten in der Stadt. Das Rosengärtchen in der Wöllbachertorstraße ist einer der stimmungsvollsten Spielorte mit seinem historischen Ambiente. Tickets sind bei Eventim und an den Vorverkaufsstellen erhältlich.

events.title: Grünberg Sommerfest am Marktplatz
events.description: The Grünberg Sommerfest takes place in the historic Marktplatz of this hilltop town in the Vogelsberg region, offering panoramic views over the surrounding countryside. Live music performances by local bands and musicians create a festive atmosphere throughout the afternoon and evening. Food stalls operated by local vereine serve Hessian specialties, grilled dishes, and homemade cakes. A children's program features games, face painting, and craft activities supervised by the town's youth organizations. The festival is a celebration of Grünberg's community spirit, bringing together residents and visitors in the picturesque old town. Free entry, with the Marktplatz's historic Town Hall (Rathaus) providing a beautiful backdrop.

events.title: Schlitz feiert – Stadtfest mit Miss-Slitisa-Wahl
events.description: Unter dem Motto 'Schlitz feiert' knüpft die Burgenstadt an die Tradition der trachtenfestfreien Jahre an und lädt am 11. und 12. Juli 2026 zum großen Stadtfest ein. Auf dem historischen Marktplatz mit seinem Kopfsteinpflaster und dem Fachwerkensemble erwartet die Besucher ein abwechslungsreiches Programm mit Livemusik, Tanz und kulinarischen Genüssen. Ein besonderer Höhepunkt ist die Wahl der ersten Miss Slitisa, die am Samstagabend gekürt wird. Das Fest bietet eine wunderbare Gelegenheit, die gastfreundliche Atmosphäre der Burgenstadt mit ihren fünf Schlössern zu erleben. Der Eintritt zum Stadtfest ist frei.

events.title: Schlitz Burgfest — Mittelalterfest auf der Vorderburg
events.description: The Schlitz Burgfest on the Vorderburg castle grounds takes visitors back to medieval times with a lively program of historical reenactment and entertainment. Knights in full armor demonstrate sword fighting and jousting techniques, while artisans display traditional crafts including blacksmithing, pottery, and weaving. Medieval music performances with traditional instruments fill the castle courtyards with authentic period sounds. Food and drink served in the Burgschänke follow medieval recipes, including hearty stews, roasted meats, and mead. The Vorderburg, one of four castles in the 'burg city' of Schlitz, offers stunning views over the Fulda Valley. Family ticket packages are available, and the festival is free for children under 6.

events.title: Homberg (Efze) Schlossfest
events.description: The Homberg (Efze) Schlossfest celebrates the city's iconic hilltop castle with a festive program of music, food, and medieval entertainment. The festival takes place in and around the historic Schloss Homberg, offering panoramic views over the Efze Valley and the Knüll mountains. Live bands perform on multiple stages, with genres ranging from folk to rock to classical. Historical reenactors in medieval costumes demonstrate crafts, sword fighting, and traditional dance. Regional wine and beer gardens, food stalls, and artisan markets line the castle courtyards. Free entry to the castle grounds makes this a popular destination for families and history enthusiasts.

events.title: Die Höchste Eisenbahn — Kulturzelt Kassel
