events.description: German indie band Die Höchste Eisenbahn performs their unique blend of melancholy and lightness at the Kulturzelt Kassel. Their songs tell stories of longing and everyday adventures, finding beauty in the ordinary with witty German lyrics and catchy melodies. They have become one of the most beloved bands in the German indie scene, evoking late-night poetry and the charm of imperfection. The concert is part of the Kulturzelt Kassel's 39th summer festival, held under the iconic big tent by the Fulda River. The intimate tent setting provides excellent acoustics and creates a warm atmosphere for their heartfelt performance. Tickets are available through the Kulturzelt website and advance booking is recommended as shows frequently sell out.
events.location: Kulturzelt Kassel, Fuldaaue (An der Drahtbrücke), 34131 Kassel

events.title: 58. Kesperkirmes – Kirschenfest in der Altstadt
events.description: Die traditionsreiche Kesperkirmes (Kirschenfest) feiert 2026 ihre 58. Auflage in der historischen Altstadt von Witzenhausen. Drei Tage lang dreht sich alles um die Kirsche – ein Höhepunkt ist die Deutsche Meisterschaft im Kirschsteinspucken, die jedes Jahr zahlreiche Schaulustige anzieht. Besondere Attraktion ist der sonntägliche verkaufsoffene Sonntag, bei dem die Geschäfte in der Altstadt zum Bummeln einladen. Live-Musik, kulinarische Stände und ein buntes Rahmenprogramm für die ganze Familie machen die Kesperkirmes zu einem der schönsten Sommerfeste Nordhessens. Der Eintritt zum Fest ist frei.

events.title: Hinter dem Spiegel — Marta Hoepffner-Preis für Fotografie
events.description: The Stadtmuseum Hofheim presents 'Hinter dem Spiegel' (Behind the Mirror), the exhibition of award-winning contemporary black-and-white photography from the Marta Hoepffner Prize. This biennial photography competition, organized in cooperation with the Kulturfonds Frankfurt RheinMain, showcases the best in contemporary German photography. The exhibition features works by multiple prize winners, exploring themes of identity, perception, and the nature of photographic representation. Marta Hoepffner (1912-2000) was a pioneering German photographer and teacher whose legacy continues through this prestigious prize. The exhibition runs from July 12 to August 30, 2026, with the Stadtmuseum open Tuesday through Sunday 11:00-17:00. Admission is approximately €5 (reduced €3), making this high-quality photography exhibition accessible to all.
events.location: Stadtmuseum Hofheim, Burgstraße 11, 65719 Hofheim am Taunus

events.title: Lauterbach Schlosspark Open Air — Klassik & Picknick
events.description: The Lauterbach Schlosspark Open Air is a classical music picnic concert set in the beautiful park of Schloss Lauterbach. Regional chamber orchestras and ensembles perform a program of classical favorites, from Mozart to Tchaikovsky, in the park's natural amphitheater. Audiences are invited to bring picnic baskets, blankets, and lawn chairs to enjoy the music in the relaxed park setting. The historic Schloss provides an elegant backdrop, while the lush park grounds create a perfect summer afternoon atmosphere. Wine and sparkling water are available from vendors throughout the park. Tickets are €15-25, with children under 12 admitted free.

events.title: Kassel Kinderfest — Family Day im Park
events.description: The Kassel Kinderfest in the Karlsaue Park is a free family event with activities and entertainment for children of all ages. A giant inflatable playground, climbing wall, and pony rides create a mini amusement park in the park's beautiful green spaces. Educational stations offer science experiments, art workshops, and building challenges, all supervised by trained youth workers. Theater performances, puppet shows, and a children's magician perform on the main stage at regular intervals. Parents can relax at the café tent while children participate in supervised activities. The event is free and runs from 10:00 to 17:00, with food and drink available from concessions.

events.title: Sommerferien-Workshop: Kreatives Gestalten für Kinder
events.description: Im Familienzentrum Mörfelden startet in den Sommerferien 2026 ein spannender Kreativ-Workshop für Kinder zwischen 6 und 13 Jahren. Die jungen Teilnehmer tauchen spielerisch in die Welt des Malens und freien Gestaltens ein und lernen dabei vielfältige künstlerische Techniken kennen. Unter fachkundiger Anleitung können sie ihrer Fantasie freien Lauf lassen und eigene Kunstwerke erschaffen. Alle Materialien werden gestellt, und die Kinder können ihre Werke am Ende mit nach Hause nehmen. Eine Anmeldung ist erforderlich, da die Teilnehmerzahl begrenzt ist. Der Workshop fördert Kreativität, Feinmotorik und Selbstvertrauen in einer entspannten Ferienatmosphäre.

events.title: Tom Jones — Come Gather Round 2026 Tour Frankfurt
events.description: Legendary Welsh singer Sir Tom Jones brings his 'Come Gather Round' world tour to Frankfurt for an unforgettable evening of music. With a career spanning over six decades, Sir Tom performs his greatest hits including 'It's Not Unusual', 'Delilah', 'Sex Bomb', and songs from his critically acclaimed later albums. His powerful baritone voice remains as commanding as ever, and his charismatic stage presence captivates audiences of all generations. The concert takes place at the Jahrhunderthalle, a premier concert venue with excellent acoustics and comfortable seating. Supporting acts and set times are announced closer to the event date. This is a rare opportunity to see a living music legend in an intimate indoor setting, before he concludes his touring career.

events.title: Rheingauer Weinsommer im Museumshof Eschborn
events.description: The Rheingauer Weinsommer transforms the historic Museumshof in Eschborn into a cozy wine garden experience every Thursday through Saturday evening. Rheingau winemakers present their finest Rieslings, Spätburgunder, and other regional wines for tasting by the glass. Visitors are welcome to bring their own food to enjoy with their wine selections, creating a convivial picnic atmosphere. The Museumshof's historic half-timbered buildings and cobblestone courtyard provide a charming setting for relaxed summer evenings. Live acoustic music on selected evenings adds to the ambiance without overwhelming conversation. Free entry with pay-per-glass pricing makes this an affordable and repeatable summer activity.

events.title: Open Air Poetry Slam — Bad Homburg
events.description: The annual Open Air Poetry Slam in Bad Homburg brings top German spoken-word artists to the beautiful Kurhausgarten for an evening of wordplay and performance. Part of the Bad Homburger Sommer festival, the event features competitive performances where poets have exactly six minutes to present original work. The audience serves as the jury, scoring each performance and determining the winner in an engaging and interactive format. Themes range from personal narratives and social commentary to humorous observations and experimental language play. The Kurhausgarten's lush greenery and evening lighting create a magical atmosphere for this literary celebration. Admission is free, making this accessible poetry event a highlight of the Bad Homburg summer calendar.
events.location: Kurhausgarten/Kurpark, 61348 Bad Homburg vor der Höhe

events.title: Marburger Sommernächte: Sportfreunde Stiller Open Air
events.description: The Marburger Sommernächte (Marburg Summer Nights) open-air concert series kicks off with German indie rock legends Sportfreunde Stiller. Known for their energetic live shows and catchy anthems like 'Ein Kompliment' and '54, 74, 90, 2010', the band performs against the stunning backdrop of Marburg Castle. The Schlossparkbühne provides a natural amphitheater with the illuminated castle creating a magical atmosphere as night falls. The Sommernächte series runs July 16-21 featuring a diverse lineup including Joris, Royal Republic, and Chris de Burgh. Food and drink vendors offer regional specialties and festival favorites throughout the evening. Tickets range from €34.65 to €69.90 and are available from the festival website and authorized ticket partners.

events.title: Nomfusi - Live-Konzert
events.description: Die suedafrikanische Sängerin Nomfusi bringt am 16. Juli 2026 im Alten E-Werk Eschwege die Seele Afrikas auf die Bühne. Mit ihrer Stimme und elektrisierender Bühnenpräsenz präsentiert sie eine Mischung aus Township Music, Soul und Afropop. Ihr Konzertprogramm kehrt zu ihren südafrikanischen Wurzeln zurueck mit groovigen Township-Sounds. Das E-Werk Eschwege ist eine bekannte Veranstaltungshalle in Nordhessen.

events.title: Grillen & Chillen am Weserstein
events.description: Am 17. Juli 2026 laedt der Ankerplatz am Weserstein in Hannoversch Münden zu 'Grillen & Chillen' ein. Die Gäste geniessen Grillspezialitäten von Tim's Catering Service am Zusammenfluss von Werra und Fulda. Der Ankerplatz bietet einen schönen Blick auf das Wasser und die historische Altstadt. Die Veranstaltung ist ideal für einen Sommerabend mit Freunden und Familie.
events.location: Ankerplatz am Weserstein, Tanzwerder, 34346 Hannoversch Münden

events.title: Hann. Münden Altstadtfest — Dreiflüssestadt feiert
events.description: Hannoversch Münden's Altstadtfest celebrates the 'Three Rivers City' where the Fulda and Werra meet to form the Weser. The festival takes place in the beautifully preserved half-timbered old town, one of the largest ensembles of half-timbered buildings in Germany. Live music, street performers, and dance groups entertain visitors across multiple stages and squares. River cruises on the Weser offer a unique perspective on the city and its historic waterfront buildings. Food specialties from the Weserbergland region include river fish dishes, local beers, and traditional baked goods. Free entry and the romantic half-timbered setting make this a highlight of the summer calendar.

events.title: Christopher Street Day Frankfurt — Pride Parade 2026
events.description: Christopher Street Day Frankfurt is one of Germany's largest and most vibrant Pride celebrations, drawing hundreds of thousands of participants from across the region. The highlight is the colorful CSD parade through the city center, featuring elaborate floats, costumed dancers, marching bands, and political activism groups. The parade route starts at the Hauptwache and winds through the city to the Mainufer, where the main stage hosts live music, speeches, and performances. The festival area along the river features food stalls, information booths, and community spaces representing LGBTQ+ organizations from across Hessen. The event runs July 16-19 with a full weekend program including parties, film screenings, and cultural events. All parade and festival area entry is free, with donations supporting LGBTQ+ community projects.
events.location: Hauptwache to Mainufer, 60313 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Limburger Sommerfest – Open-Air-Konzert im Serenadenhof
events.description: Die Limburger Sommerfeste laden auch 2026 wieder zu stimmungsvollen Open-Air-Konzerten im Serenadenhof zwischen Stadthalle und St. Anna Kirche ein. An diesem Samstagabend präsentiert das zweite Sommerfest Livemusik verschiedener Genres bei freiem Eintritt. Die Konzertreihe hat sich als fester Bestandteil des Limburger Veranstaltungskalenders etabliert und lockt mit einer Mischung aus Rock, Pop und Blasmusik. Biergartenbestuhlung und kulinarische Angebote sorgen für Wohlfühlatmosphäre unter freiem Himmel. Sitzplätze können nicht reserviert werden, daher empfiehlt sich frühzeitiges Erscheinen.
events.location: Serenadenhof, Diezer Straße 13, 65549 Limburg an der Lahn

events.title: Orgelpunkt 2026 - Orgelkonzert
events.description: Im Jubiläumsjahr '500 Jahre Homberger Synode' findet in der Stadtkirche St. Marien der 'Orgelpunkt 2026' statt. An jedem dritten Samstag im Monat um 12:00 Uhr erklingt 30 Minuten Orgelmusik am Ort der historischen Synode von 1526. Die Konzerte bieten Orgelmusik in der historischen Kirche St. Marien. Der Eintritt ist frei, um eine Spende für Kirchenmusik wird gebeten.

events.title: Alte Bekannte — Mehr! Live Open Air Marburg
events.description: Germany's most successful a-cappella vocal ensemble, Alte Bekannte, performs at the Schlossparkbühne in Marburg as part of the Sommernächte series. With over 160 shows since their formation in 2021, the group has become a phenomenon with their unique blend of pop, rock, and classical crossover. Using only their voices — no instruments — they recreate complex arrangements of hits by artists from Queen to Ed Sheeran with astonishing precision. Their live shows are known for their humor, audience interaction, and jaw-dropping vocal virtuosity. The Schlossparkbühne's natural amphitheater setting with Marburg Castle illuminated above provides a magical backdrop. Tickets start at €34.65 and are available through the Marburger Sommernächte website.
